hidden.tokens: All effective prefill input positions, including expanded sensor tokens and prompt text; no generated answer tokens.
hidden.stage: Output of the complete decoder block, before final model norm; no participant weighting.

kv.tokens: Global aligned token axis; unavailable current-layer KV rows contribute zero on the participant side; full Cen reference retained.
kv.stage: Actual cached post-RoPE K and projected V with native KV heads; availability before causal query masking.

note: Fidelity uses fixed matched samples across configurations within each task. Each sample receives equal weight, including when shard sizes differ.
display_conversion: CSV mean_percent = 100 * mean; missing means remain null.
uncertainty_units: std and sem retain the original ratio units.
